policies.text: Authorization for commercial store placement is granted for a product meeting regional safety compliance that keeps its customer returns rate at or below 5 percent this year.
Outdoor durability approval requires equipment to possess IP67 waterproof certification.
Long-life power endorsement is granted when a wearable demonstrates a battery standby time exceeding 10 days.
A commercial item receives green packaging designation if its recyclable content proportion equals or exceeds 75 percent.
Regional safety compliance is achieved when an item maintains an acoustic safety rating of at least 80 points along with holding CE mark certification.
A merchant account gains express fulfillment privileges when maintaining an order accuracy metric of at least 98 percent this quarter.
